about_the_game:
Dino-Might is a competitive party fighting game where you control a tiny-armed t-rex in a prehistoric smackdown. Battle 2-4 players in fast-paced local or online multiplayer matches -- only one dino will be crowned the winner!

Multiplayer Mayhem

Enjoy your last moments in the prehistoric arena with friends or foes! Battle it out in 2-4 player matches, whether you're smackin’ dinos on the couch or throwing down online.

Local Play: Grab some controllers and challenge your buddies! (Controllers required.)

Online Play: Face off with friends or rivals using a keyboard or controller.

Entertaining Tiny-Arm Combat

Tiny arms, big impact! In true arcade, inspired controls, jump at the right angle, commit to the strike, and take down your foes. Mistime it, and you’re dino toast!

ANYONE CAN PLAY!

Not a gamer? That's okay! The controls are simple and intuitive. Even you're grandma could play (and win!). Simple controls, but endless strategy for the sweaty gamers. 

Adorable Dino Customization

Personalize your dino with a variety of colors and accessories. Feeling cowboy cute today? Or how about pierced punk? Well, in Dino-Might, you can change it up each game.  

Exciting Powerful Pickups

Quick, get that fireball before your opponent does! Use an array of game-changing pickups like fireballs, speed boosts, double jumps, and invisibility to gain the upper hand. 

Let Out Your Rawr!

YOU CAN RAWR! Enough said.

short_description: Dino-Might is a 2-4 player party fighting game where you control a tiny-armed t-rex in a fierce battle! Use arcade-inspired movement and power-ups to eliminate opponents, all while avoiding hazards. Easy to pick up, hard to put down, and built for all gamers. Only the best dino will survive!
